name: Takei Masae
source:
A part-time staffer at Imabiki Chinese Restaurant.

Her boss chewed her out pretty bad for showing up at work with [url=/v4307]her nails manicured black[/url]. She was ordered to go to the restroom and scrub them clean, but no amount of nail polish remover was able to do the trick, and so she's been dealing with her boss's wrath all day long.

[Edited from in-game TIPS]
